    Bug 1950637 - Move configuration variables from confvars.sh to moz.configure r=coreycb
    
    This matches the recent configuration changes in mozilla-central: only
    variable flagged as confvar should be set in confvars.sh
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D239871

diff --git a/mail/confvars.sh b/mail/confvars.sh
index 9c171796d98..cda9184b6b4 100755
--- a/mail/confvars.sh
+++ b/mail/confvars.sh
@@ -3,7 +3,4 @@
 # License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
 # file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
 
-MOZ_APP_NAME=thunderbird
-MOZ_APP_PROFILE=thunderbird
-
 MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/nightly
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index ccf3f9ae040..0d2bfde4efe 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -7,6 +7,8 @@
 set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD", True)
 set_define("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD", True)
 
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_NAME", "thunderbird")
+imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird")
 imply_option("MOZ_APP_BASENAME", "Thunderbird")
 set_config("MOZ_APPUPDATE_HOST", "aus.thunderbird.net")
